svg.title: Relative denominators feed Fourfold Iitaka. Its chain lemmas and Stein degrees feed Uniform Iitaka. Normal lc indices feed Log Iitaka and slc indices; product covers in Log Iitaka also feed slc indices.

a.aria-label: Theorem 1.1 / Proposition 6.1 · pp. 2, 15: Controls moduli denominators and supplies a uniform degree generating the full field of a positive-dimensional big base.
Theorem 1.1 · p. 1: Bounds the Stein degree of a coefficient-one component, controlling the index when a principal divisor descends by a field norm.

Lemma 5.1 / Corollary 5.2 / Lemma 5.4 · pp. 18, 20–21: Constructs a rational fibration from chains of covering families and bounds section orders and degrees on its leaves. Uses the arbitrary-dimensional chain lemmas, rather than the fourfold main theorem.
Theorem 11.1 · p. 73: Passes from nonnegative Iitaka dimension to a good model, where the effective-degree argument uses the semiample fibration.
Theorem 1.2 · p. 2: Supplies a uniform trivializing degree on the generic fibre, fixing an exact pullback presentation.
Proposition 5.1 / Lemmas 5.2–5.3 · pp. 12–13: Uses a quasi-étale product cover and stability under further covers to control the character on the volume form factor by factor.
Theorem 1.2 · p. 2: Trivializes all lc normalization components in one even degree. The receiving paper adds conductor gluing.
